# dsh-compaction-sticky-window
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness profile bundle that replaces the summarizing context compactor with **a model-wri
tten handoff note and a fresh window that keeps almost nothing else**.
The shipped backend condenses an old span into a model-written summary: one extra model call per rol
lover, and a summary whose contents the model did not choose. This backend inverts the ownership. Th
e model writes its own note with `sticky_note`, opens a new window with `new_context`, and that wind
ow starts with the system prompt, the note, and the work in flight — nothing else. One deterministic
fallback remains for automatic pressure: if no note was written, the evicted messages are reduced t
o the facts the log can prove.
## Install
From a checkout of this repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or through the Plugins page, which installs the bundle and enables it. The bundle patch retires the
summarizing backend on every plane the profile exposes, so nothing else needs composing.
## What installing adds, and what it replaces
Installing adds four tools and replaces the compaction backend. It takes no tool away, and it does n
ot change which preset your sessions use.
| Profile kind | Compaction owner | What the bundle does |
| CLI, headless, SDK | A host-plane row from the base bundle | Disables `compaction-basic` and inser

ts this backend in its place; the four tools are added |
| Web, Desktop | Each agent preset, inside
a group that isolates `compaction` | Overrides the shipped `standard` preset in place — same id, sam
e order — swapping only its compaction group |
On a preset-backed profile a host-plane row cannot reach a session: the preset isolates `compaction`
, so its own backend serves its own agents. The supported way in is to override the preset declarati
on by its Loader row id, which replaces that preset's whole `config`. `presets/sticky-window.patch.y
ml` is exactly that: the shipped `standard` preset, restated, with one group changed. Because the pr
eset keeps its id and order, **nothing needs selecting** — the summarizing backend is gone as soon a
d and order, **nothing needs selecting** — the summarizing backend is gone as soon as the bundle is.
This bundle still never touches `agent-preset-registry`. Forcing a different default preset would sw
itch every open session onto an unfamiliar preset, which is a different operation from replacing a b
ackend inside the preset those sessions already use.
The restated child list is the shipped `standard` list with the compaction group swapped, and `npm r
un sync-preset` refuses to write a snapshot whose plugin ids differ from the installation it read. R
e-run it after a DSH upgrade.
## The window lifecycle
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Sequence: the model opens a window
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Sequence: automatic pressure
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Automatic pressure is a three-stage ramp, not a cliff:
| Stage | At | What happens |
| warning | `threshold − warnTokens` | A notice asks for the note while there is still room to write

it. |
| exhausted | `threshold` | A second notice says the window's budget is spent and the next ac

tion is `sticky_note` then `new_context`. A rollover happens here **only if a note is saved**. |
| b
locked | `ceiling = min(threshold + fallbackTokens, capacity)` | With no saved note the window still
does not end; the notice now says writing the note is the only action that matters. |
[该节后续省略]
## Why this shape
- **The model owns the handoff.** A summary the model did not write is a guess about what matters. T
he reference implementations hand that decision to the model and give it a gate that makes writing i

t obligatory before a rollover it requests.
- **No side storage.** The note, the pins, and the archi
ve index are ordinary surface content or existing log events, so fork, resume, and replay need no ex

tra persistence and no format version.
- **No new session events.** The mechanism rides the existing

`compaction/*` vocabulary.
- **No dependence on internal APIs.** The backend extends the published
`BasicCompactionEngine` and overrides the documented `summarize()` hook; everything else is the ship
Engine` and overrides the documented `summarize()` hook; everything else is the shipped transaction.
## Known limitations
- The model can still under-write. When it does, the note carries only the recorded facts and says n

o handoff was written; it never fabricates one.
- If the model never writes a note, the window holds
out until a provider-confirmed overflow forces it. That is deliberate — an unprepared rollover lose
s state — but it means a model that ignores every notice reaches the hard failure instead of a quiet

one.
- The note's handoff is read from the whole session, so a note written in the turn that trigge

rs a rollover is still carried.
- A single indivisible message larger than the window cannot be repa

ired by a rollover; the optional tool-result pruner still runs before selection.
- The override is a
snapshot of `standard` at the targeted DSH release. A DSH upgrade can change that preset without th
is package noticing; run `sync-preset` and publish a new version. Verified at the targeted release:

the restated list has the same 19 top-level plugin ids as the installation.
- The override applies t
o sessions **started after** the bundle is enabled. A session already running keeps the preset it mo
unted at start, so restart (or open a new session) to pick up the new backend; the tools it already

has do not change either way.
- Push notices are appended as ordinary `user/message` events with the
`sticky-window-notice` source kind. The session format admits extension source kinds, so a log stay

s readable after the plugin is removed, but an older reader will not know that kind by name.
- On a
DSH release whose base backend compacts on a **model switch** through a path that bypasses `compactI
fNeeded`, that switch can still roll over without the note gate. The targeted 0.2.0 line has no such
path; a later line would need this backend to gate it too.
